headline: Antonelli wins the Chinese Grand Prix
standfirst: Kimi Antonelli won the Chinese Grand Prix for Mercedes, finishing 5.515s ahead of George Russell, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium after 56 laps of Shanghai.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Kimi Antonelli lined up first on the grid. Hamilton got the better launch and led the field across the line at the end of the opening lap. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Alonso, up 8 places to 10th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 1 time. Laps led: Antonelli (55) and Hamilton (1). Antonelli took the lead for good on lap 2. The race was neutralised by 1 safety car period (lap 10–13).

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Antonelli made 1 stop, running medium → hard tyres. The field made 19 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.4s for Hamilton on lap 10. 9 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Carlos Sainz made up the most ground, climbing 8 places from 17th to 9th. Timing recorded 279 on-track position changes, 26 of them by Ocon.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Verstappen (lap 46), Alonso (lap 33) and Stroll (lap 10) failed to finish. Norris, Bortoleto, Albon and Piastri did not take the start.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 20°C to 23°C, with air at 15–16°C. Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap, a 1:35.275 on lap 52.
